title: Almond, Pumpkin Seed and Goji Berry Muesli
changes_from_base: No grated apple, yoghurt or juice: a dry mix of oats, raisins, goji berries, toasted almonds and pumpkin seeds is soaked overnight in milk alone and topped with fresh berries.
summary: A breakfast of wholegrain oats combined with dried fruit, toasted nuts and seeds, then soaked overnight and crowned with fresh berries.
equipment: medium bowl with a lid (or cling film)

steps.title: Toast Almonds
steps.text: In a dry frying pan over medium heat, toast 25 g flaked almonds for 3-4 minutes, stirring, until golden; tip out, cool and chop roughly.

steps.title: Toast Seeds
steps.text: Toast 35 g pumpkin seeds in the same pan for 2-3 minutes until they puff and pop, then set aside.

steps.title: Combine Mix
steps.text: Mix 135 g rolled oats, 35 g raisins, 30 g goji berries, the chopped almonds and toasted seeds in a medium bowl; this dry mixture keeps 2 weeks airtight.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Stir 400 ml semi-skimmed milk into the mixture, cover and chill overnight.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Next morning stir the muesli, divide between 4 bowls and top with 140 g mixed blueberries, raspberries and blackberries.

tips: Toast the almonds and seeds whilst the pan heats to develop deeper flavour
Prepare and combine the dry ingredients up to 2 weeks ahead for grab-and-go breakfasts
Top with fresh berries just before serving to keep them crisp
storage: The dry mixture keeps 2 weeks in an airtight container. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
